verdict.rationale: Model failover is a fair axis for a self-hosted assistant that supports many LLM providers. The evidence documents only multi-provider support, setting a default `provider/model`, and the `/model` chat command for manual switching. Nothing documents automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits; the only "fallback" mention is SSH tunneling for remote access, which is unrelated.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
